final.name: Grandiose opening framing vs narrow delivered contribution
final.audit_justification: Assessing whether the opening framing is proportionate to the actual delivered contribution requires substantively reading and weighing technical content, so it is evidence about calibration/honesty rather than a surface stylistic tell.

final.name: Formal-theory signaling
final.audit_justification: Counts formal-theory vocabulary regardless of correctness or importance, a stylistic/subfield marker, though genuinely rigorous theoretical work could also be the upstream cause of heavier formal language.

final.name: Structural Inductive-Bias Fit
final.audit_justification: Judges whether architectural or objective choices are substantively justified by domain structure versus adopted for fashion, a genuine methodological-quality judgment.

final.name: Contribution attribution
final.audit_justification: Presence of ablations or controlled contrasts that isolate contributions is genuine evidentiary craft, not a stylistic marker.

final.name: Judgability from printed text alone, no title recognition
final.audit_justification: Measures whether the text is complete/self-contained enough to be judged at all, a data-completeness/production-circumstance check rather than a signal of the underlying research's quality.
final.arbiter_reason: The gradient is dominated by whether the record contains an abstract body at all (0 = missing or a title-only stub), which is a data-completeness and judge-contamination check on the corpus rather than evidence about the research; the cited R20 case shows exactly this, since a truncated record says nothing about the paper's quality. Missing or stub abstracts arise from collection artifacts that do not themselves produce better or worse research, so no undiscounted readout is warranted.

final.name: Assumption discipline
final.audit_justification: Whether assumptions and boundary conditions are stated precisely is a substantive rigor criterion.

final.name: Acronym and method-name density
final.audit_justification: Counts naming/acronym density irrespective of usefulness, a jargon-style marker, though genuinely novel multi-component work could also drive higher naming density.

final.name: Code/data release statement presence
final.audit_justification: Scores only the textual presence of a release statement, not artifact quality, though the same care or resourcing that prompts release statements could also produce genuinely better work.

final.name: Ambiguity Awareness
final.audit_justification: Recognizing multiple valid explanations or targets and designing the objective accordingly is a substantive methodological sophistication signal.

final.name: Artifact-availability cues
final.audit_justification: Near-duplicate of the release-statement criterion, scoring only presence of availability cues, with the same plausible resourcing/care confound.

final.name: Headline rests on an idea rather than on a leaderboard position
final.audit_justification: Judges whether a substantive, statable claim survives once leaderboard numbers are removed, a genuine assessment of intellectual content versus rank-chasing.

final.name: Formalism density
final.audit_justification: Duplicate of X02, scoring extent of formal/mathematical terminology only and explicitly excluding rigor or correctness, though real theoretical rigor is a plausible upstream cause.

final.name: Abstract length
final.audit_justification: Explicitly judges length and elaboration only, not whether the added detail is good, though more thorough underlying work could plausibly also produce longer abstracts.

final.name: Claim-aligned validation
final.audit_justification: Whether the validation design directly targets the claimed phenomenon with a real control is genuine evidentiary rigor.

final.name: Editorial polish
final.audit_justification: Explicitly textual polish only, not research quality, though the writing skill or resourcing that produces polish could also correlate with genuinely careful work.

final.name: Trend/hype-keyword density
final.audit_justification: Counts fashionable buzzwords regardless of whether their use is warranted, a topic/fashion marker whose upstream cause (working in a trendy area) does not itself imply better work.

final.name: Enumerated contribution scaffolding and numbered-pitfall templates
final.audit_justification: An explicit structural/template marker (numbered contribution scaffolding) that must not be read as organization quality or validity, and is a common boilerplate convention largely independent of rigor.

final.name: Scarcity Leverage
final.audit_justification: Whether a method exploits scarcity through a reusable structural advantage versus assuming abundant resources is a substantive methodological judgment.

final.name: Mechanistic Explanatory Depth
final.audit_justification: Causal explanatory depth with testable implications versus bare component introduction is core substantive quality.

final.name: Operational Specificity
final.audit_justification: Whether the abstract specifies enough mechanism, assumptions, and setup to reconstruct the contribution is genuine operational rigor, not style.

final.name: Theory-Practice Coupling
final.audit_justification: Whether theoretical analysis actually constrains or predicts the method's behavior versus being detached is a substantive rigor judgment.

final.name: Evaluation breadth
final.audit_justification: Explicitly scores breadth of claimed coverage only, not whether it is adequate or convincing, though the compute/resourcing enabling broad evaluation could also enable genuinely better work.

final.name: Long-range information preservation
final.audit_justification: Requiring an explicit, explained route for stable long-range information access versus mere assertion is a substantive architectural-quality judgment.

final.name: Economy of mechanism relative to size of the consequence
final.audit_justification: Judging the ratio of mechanism simplicity to claimed consequence is a substantive assessment of intellectual economy, not a stylistic tell.

final.name: New reusable dataset or benchmark contributed alongside method
final.audit_justification: Whether the paper contributes a new reusable dataset or benchmark identifies a genuine, substantive type of research contribution rather than a stylistic marker.
